text:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — PR #462 adds an optional top-level field `billable_units` to /v1/usage responses. Pinging @Jamie and @Chris for accounting/backcompat implications.
Jamie Park: saw the PR, thanks. Is `billable_units` computed server-side as the canonical number for billing? or just a convenience?
Alex Chen: server-side canonical. It's intended to be a flat integer consumers can use for billing without reconstructing prompt/completion/cached math. falls back to old fields if absent.
Chris (eng-accounting): prefer a clear fallback rule in the contract. if `billable_units` missing, we should define exact reconstruction: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_tokens? Any edge cases?
Suyin Rao: edge case: streaming partials. If client reconnects mid-stream we might emit incremental token deltas. That could make naive reconstruction off. We should document that `billable_units` is authoritative and recommended.
Mike O'Neill: SDK note — if we add `billable_units` we should not break existing parsers. Plan: add field, mark optional, no schema major bump. SDK will fall back to computed value if field absent.
Jamie Park: +1. Need a tiny JSON example in the API docs to reduce confusion. Suggested example:
```
{
  "prompt_tokens": 12,
  "completion_tokens": 88,
  "cached_tokens": 4,
  "billable_units": 96
}
```
Alex Chen: exact example looks good. Also proposing: when streaming, servers include a final `billable_units` in the terminal event so reconcilers don't try to sum intermediate deltas.
billing-bot: Deploy notice: usage-api v1.12.0 deployed to staging (sha: a1b2c3).
Chris (eng-accounting): can we add a small note about rounding/quantization? some quantized model paths measure tokenization slightly differently (subword boundary shifts). we need to say "billable_units" is what billing charges, regardless of tiny tokenizer diffs.
Suyin Rao: agreed. Also add a migration window: optional for 30 days, then recommended for all clients. not enforced.
Mike O'Neill: action items: 1) Alex — add explicit fallback reconstruction formula in PR description and docs. 2) Jamie — add JSON example + streaming terminal event note. 3) Chris — confirm billing reconciler uses `billable_units` when present. 4) Suyin — add migration note and example for reconnect scenarios.
Alex Chen: will update PR and docs today, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/462
Jamie Park: thanks. I'll queue an SDK patch to read `billable_units` if present, else compute. will target a minor release. :thumbsup:
Chris (eng-accounting): once staging is stable can run a small reconciliation on last 48h to ensure values match expectations.
Alex Chen: awesome. If no objections I'll merge after docs patch. leaving thread open for 24h for accounting signoff. :eyes:
